A Randomized Evaluation of MoodFX, a Patient-Centred e-Health Tool to Support Outcome Measurement for Depression
item.description: MoodFX is a patient-centered e-health tool designed to support outcome measurement for depression. This randomized evaluation demonstrates its effectiveness in helping patients track symptoms and improve treatment outcomes.
